resumen: Cleric and **main healer** in all 5 raids (4.8–5.3k HPS, 2.5 to 3.3 times the group average) who also adds 37–44k DPS. With the usual group, Cry lasts longer than almost anyone: in 35 of the 50 attempts where Cry died, the wipe came within the next 10 s, so that death usually closes the attempt rather than causing it (inference). New on Nov 7 19:06: 17440000 was not used and DPS was the lowest of all 5 nights.
fortalezas: First death comes later than the group average in all 5 raids (138 s versus 119 s on Nov 6; 142 s versus 132 s on Nov 7 19:06).
Falls first in only 5 of 62 attempts and last in 22 (ties included).
Takes less damage than average in every raid and dies less per attempt than average in 4 of the 5.
Keeps healing steady (4.8–5.3k HPS) even on the longest nights.
mejorar: On Nov 7 19:06, 17440000 does not appear at all; on the other 4 nights it made up 9 to 11% of Cry’s damage. DPS was 36.8k (14% below average, the lowest of all nights) and 17350000 rose to 41% of the total.

That night Cry’s crit rate dropped to 26.7% (31.6–32.2% on the others). FunPeople (48.6 → 38.4%) and Izumi (38.2 → 28.3%) dropped too and there was no Chanter in the group: the missing Chanter buffs are the likely reason, not something Cry alone did (inference).
With the usual group, in 18 of those 50 attempts Cry died before 100 s, ahead of the zone phase: besides the 130–175 s wall there are early wipes.
Top killers: 1802750 (8 times), 1802716 from 2920725 (8), 1802720 (8) and 1802850 from 2920718 (7). 16 deaths have no recorded ability.
recomendaciones: If dropping 17440000 wasn’t on purpose, put it back: it was 9–11% of your damage. If you swapped it for healing or survival, check in the next raid whether it pays off.
In the 130–175 s window, prioritize survival: with the usual group, once the healing goes down the attempt ends within seconds.
Dodge 1802750 and leave 2920725 early: together they account for 16 of your deaths.
Until the group gets past the zone phase, a pre-emptive heal or shield before 130 s is worth more than extra DPS.
